workflows.name: fix-slow-checkout-page
workflows.description: Diagnose and optimize a slow checkout page using performance monitoring, React/Next.js best practices, Stripe integration review, and full-stack query optimization.

steps.instruction: Run Chrome DevTools MCP to measure Core Web Vitals (LCP, INP, CLS) on the checkout page for desktop and mobile. Have the LLM analyze the lab and field metrics, identify the worst-performing web vital, and summarize the most likely frontend causes.

Run a Lighthouse audit on the checkout route using the web-performance-optimization skill. Ask the LLM to combine Lighthouse findings with the Core Web Vitals data and produce a prioritized list of fixes for issues like render-blocking resources, large JavaScript bundles, and slow resource loading.

Review the checkout page implementation using Vercel React best practices. Instruct the LLM to detect server/client component misuse, missing Suspense boundaries, excessive client-state effects, large context providers, and expensive un-memoized components, then refactor the code accordingly.

Audit the Stripe integration using Stripe best practices. Have the LLM verify that Checkout Sessions or PaymentIntents are used correctly, Stripe.js is loaded asynchronously, unnecessary API calls are eliminated, and the payment flow does not block the main thread or add avoidable network round trips.

Trace the backend performance of checkout endpoints using eng-performance-optimization. Ask the LLM to inspect Hono/API route latency, database queries, N+1 problems, missing indexes, and caching opportunities; then optimize slow queries, add edge caching, and set appropriate cache-control headers.

Re-run cf-web-perf and Lighthouse on the optimized checkout page. Have the LLM compare before/after metrics, verify that Core Web Vitals pass, check for regressions, and document any remaining performance risks with next-step recommendations.

advice.summary: Deploy ml-explore-run and pi-web-search skills for search and source exploration, connect hannesrudolph-mcp-ragdocs for documentation retrieval, coordinate research subagents with crewai, use ripgrep and Playwright to verify sources, and consult anthropic-api-docs and realtime-chat-docs to produce structured, citation-backed reports with product-catalog and search features.

actions: Use ripgrep and Playwright for source exploration and verification
Verify citations and source quality, then finalize

steps: Use ripgrep and Playwright for source exploration and verification; include product-catalog and search
Consult anthropic-api-docs and realtime-chat-docs to validate outputs
Implement, verify citations and source quality, then complete

Live research first: catalog coverage is weak (skills, workflows, mcpservers). Run discover_all('Build a researcher AI agent that conducts deep research on any topic using web search, documentation') and web-search the official repos, then re-run get_task_advice.

PERSIST everything into the working project: save every skill/workflow/MCP/agent/docs you load under .mcp-skills/ (skills/, workflows/, mcpservers/, agents/, docs/) plus this full advice under .mcp-skills/advice/, write/update AGENTS.md at the project root with the manifest + this plan, and set up a knowledge graph in the project: Obsidian vault (.obsidian + linked notes per domain/decision/component) and a Graphify code graph (graphify-out/graph.json built from the codebase).

REPORT BACK after each step: update the Obsidian notes + Graphify graph with what changed, run a graph query (graphify query/path/explain) and pass ONLY the relevant graph summary + this advice as context to the LLM (prevents token burning), then call get_task_advice with the updated status, persist the refreshed advice into .mcp-skills/advice/, and continue - never run multiple steps without re-checking.
cautions: Verify facts and source quality before adding any citation to the report.
Use exact catalog names from the report; do not substitute alternatives.
Run verification after each phase before moving to the next step.

steps.instruction: Run Chrome DevTools MCP to measure Core Web Vitals (LCP, INP, CLS) on the checkout page for desktop and mobile. Have the LLM analyze the lab and field metrics, identify the worst-performing web vital, and summarize the most likely frontend causes.

Run a Lighthouse audit on the checkout route using the web-performance-optimization skill. Ask the LLM to combine Lighthouse findings with the Core Web Vitals data and produce a prioritized list of fixes for issues like render-blocking resources, large JavaScript bundles, and slow resource loading.

Review the checkout page implementation using Vercel React best practices. Instruct the LLM to detect server/client component misuse, missing Suspense boundaries, excessive client-state effects, large context providers, and expensive un-memoized components, then refactor the code accordingly.

Audit the Stripe integration using Stripe best practices. Have the LLM verify that Checkout Sessions or PaymentIntents are used correctly, Stripe.js is loaded asynchronously, unnecessary API calls are eliminated, and the payment flow does not block the main thread or add avoidable network round trips.

Trace the backend performance of checkout endpoints using eng-performance-optimization. Ask the LLM to inspect Hono/API route latency, database queries, N+1 problems, missing indexes, and caching opportunities; then optimize slow queries, add edge caching, and set appropriate cache-control headers.

Re-run cf-web-perf and Lighthouse on the optimized checkout page. Have the LLM compare before/after metrics, verify that Core Web Vitals pass, check for regressions, and document any remaining performance risks with next-step recommendations.

report.title: Executive Summary
report.content: Build a researcher agent using crewai orchestration, ml-explore-run and pi-web-search skills, and hannesrudolph-mcp-ragdocs for documentation retrieval. Use ripgrep and Playwright to verify sources and produce structured, citation-backed reports with product-catalog and search features. Validate outputs against anthropic-api-docs and realtime-chat-docs.

report.title: Goals & Success Criteria
report.content: Implement a deep-research agent that searches web, documentation, and source code, verifies facts and source quality, and outputs structured citation-backed reports. Integrate product-catalog and search features. Use exact catalog components: hannesrudolph-mcp-ragdocs, exa-mcp, rag-documentation-mcp-server, crewai, ml-explore-run, pi-web-search, deep-research, ripgrep, Playwright, and Selenium.

report.title: Core Engineering Constraints
report.content: Use exact catalog names from the report; do not substitute alternatives. Verify facts and source quality before adding any citation. Run verification after each phase before moving to the next step. Use the locally-running agent-mcp-orchestrator to discover MCP servers before wiring them into the workflow.

report.title: Target Architecture & Stack
report.content: Coordinate research subagents with crewai. Use ml-explore-run and pi-web-search for search and source exploration, hannesrudolph-mcp-ragdocs for documentation retrieval, and ripgrep plus Playwright for source verification. Include product-catalog and search features in the report generation pipeline. Consult anthropic-api-docs and realtime-chat-docs to validate report structure.

report.title: Repository / Monorepo Strategy
report.content: Organize the project as a crewai codebase with skills loaded from ml-explore-run and pi-web-search. Use ripgrep to explore local source and Playwright or Selenium for live source verification. Keep MCP server configurations for hannesrudolph-mcp-ragdocs, exa-mcp, and rag-documentation-mcp-server in the repository.

report.title: Functional Domain Decomposition
report.content: Target web search, documentation retrieval, source exploration, fact verification, and structured reporting. Use product-catalog and search features to organize research outputs. Apply reviews-ratings when assessing source quality and use fix-slow-checkout-page as a performance-optimization test case.

report.title: Data Architecture & Schema
report.content: Ingest data from web search via pi-web-search, documentation via hannesrudolph-mcp-ragdocs, and source exploration via ripgrep and Playwright. Maintain citation metadata and source-quality scores. Use product-catalog and search features to index retrieved sources and reports.

report.title: API Methodology
report.content: Use anthropic-api-docs and realtime-chat-docs to shape report generation and citation formatting. Use fastmcp-docs to configure MCP servers. Call agent-mcp-orchestrator methods get_mcp_status, list_mcp_servers, get_server_info, get_server_logs, and get_open_incidents to discover and monitor available APIs.

report.title: Frontend / UI Methodology
report.content: Build a product-catalog and search frontend for browsing research reports. Use Playwright and Selenium to automate UI verification. Use trae or openhands as the agent platform for frontend and interactive review tasks.

report.title: Agent-MCP Operating Model
report.content: Create crewai subagents: a research agent using ml-explore-run and pi-web-search, a documentation agent using hannesrudolph-mcp-ragdocs, and a verification agent using ripgrep and Playwright. Coordinate them with the deep-research workflow. Use fw-research-optimize-execute to optimize execution.

report.title: System MCP Discovery (agent-mcp-orchestrator)
report.content: Before starting, call agent-mcp-orchestrator's list_mcp_servers to discover every MCP server on the system. Use get_mcp_status and get_server_info to check availability and capabilities, get_server_logs to debug failures, and get_open_incidents to identify degraded servers. Wire suitable discovered servers, especially hannesrudolph-mcp-ragdocs, exa-mcp, and rag-documentation-mcp-server, into the other sections of this report. Re-run get_mcp_status after each phase to confirm connectivity.

report.title: Knowledge / Memory Model
report.content: Store retrieved documentation and source excerpts in a knowledge base indexed by product-catalog and search features. Use the deep-research skill to organize findings. Consult anthropic-api-docs and realtime-chat-docs for the report schema and citation format.

report.title: Project Knowledge Persistence & Re-Advice Loop
report.content: Maintain a project knowledge file listing MCP servers discovered via agent-mcp-orchestrator and their statuses. Record verification results from ripgrep and Playwright. Update project knowledge after each phase with decisions and source-quality assessments.

report.title: Full Development Lifecycle
report.content: Follow Setup, Implement, and Verify phases. In Setup, load skills and connect MCP servers. In Implement, execute the fix-slow-checkout-page workflow and use ripgrep and Playwright. In Verify, consult anthropic-api-docs and realtime-chat-docs, verify citations, and finalize the report.

report.title: Testing Strategy
report.content: Use Playwright and Selenium to test product-catalog and search features. Use ripgrep to verify citations against local source and documentation. Run verification after each phase before moving to the next step.

report.title: Deployment & Environments
report.content: Deploy the crewai agent with hannesrudolph-mcp-ragdocs, exa-mcp, and rag-documentation-mcp-server configured. Ensure agent-mcp-orchestrator reports all MCP servers healthy via get_mcp_status. Use trae or openhands for deployment monitoring.

report.title: Implementation Phases
report.content: Setup: load ml-explore-run and pi-web-search, connect hannesrudolph-mcp-ragdocs, and initialize crewai. Implement: execute fix-slow-checkout-page, use ripgrep and Playwright, and include product-catalog and search features. Verify: consult anthropic-api-docs and realtime-chat-docs, verify citations and source quality, then finalize.

report.title: Master Backlog / TODOs
report.content: Add integration tasks for exa-mcp and rag-documentation-mcp-server. Add reviews-ratings source scoring and the fw-research-optimize-execute workflow. Track performance-optimization fixes derived from fix-slow-checkout-page.

report.title: Definition of Done
report.content: Done means all phases verified, citations checked against sources, and a structured report generated with product-catalog and search features. All MCP servers discovered via agent-mcp-orchestrator are healthy. No unverified citations remain.

report.title: Risks & Mitigations
report.content: MCP server outages or degraded status may be detected via get_open_incidents. Source quality varies; use reviews-ratings and ripgrep or Playwright verification. Exact catalog names must be used; substitutions break the workflow.

report.title: First Execution Checklist
report.content: Load skills, connect MCP servers, initialize crewai, execute the workflow, use ripgrep and Playwright, include product-catalog and search, consult docs, verify citations, and finalize the report.
